name: HEURO
oneLiner: HEUR is HEURO SAS's euro electronic-money token, with issuer-described cash backing and par redemption; public mainnet supply remains unverified.
collateral: Issuer-described euro cash and high-quality liquid assets in a segregated fiduciary estate; current composition and named reserve institutions remain unverified.
pegMechanism: The issuer white paper describes free euro redemption at par following holder onboarding, compliance checks and token return, with an aim of five business days before additional bank processing.

proofOfReserves.provider: Heuro SAS; monthly and quarterly report claims were not reconciled to a retrieved dated token-reserve report

launchPhaseDetail: HEURO SAS published its white paper on February 26, 2026 and says HEUR is issued on Ethereum and Solana. Public mainnet addresses and positive supply remain unverified; no admitted price or supply lane is available.

milestones.title: HEURO electronic-money white paper published
milestones.description: Heuro SAS publishes the HEUR white paper describing euro backing, public-chain transfer and holder redemption. Its publication date does not verify public mainnet issuance.
